review_scope: Targeted correction of persistent late hot core and unchanged single-plume structure; not overall cinematic acceptance
targeted_findings: The irregular pale ignition remains brief with a feathered edge, followed by a weaker launch jet.
At age14 and later the launch/core image and preview warm receiver factor are exactly zero; decoded frames contain cold smoke instead of the lingering bright core.
At ages14,36,66 and95, the visible outline, dominant fold groupings and remaining fragments change. Different births/roll/erosion/lifetimes replace parts of the earlier cloud.
Late dust remains at the fixed source while the smoke cloud lifts and later becomes thin remnants.
The side-by-side late pair clearly separates v002a's persistent bright source and original plume from v003's lifted cold, differently grouped cloud.
decision: The two specified defects pass this targeted frame/native-driver review. Provide the source as a candidate for production's separate integrated proof. Overall cinematic motion, 4K and moving-scene integration remain unaccepted.
candid_limits: Audit used native-size decoded export frames and native trajectory/opacity inspection; no real-time video playback was performed by this audit.
Only four underlying painted forms are reused across13 moving layers; recognizable texture reuse can still occur.
The smoke is2.5D painted value, not volumetric fluid flow or physically evolving self-shadow/relighting.
The lifted cloud becomes broad and fades strongly toward the end; judge this timing against production's actual stumble and camera.
Held camera/children and baked proof maps do not establish live occlusion, contact, performance or4K detail.
